items.title: Binance $6.3 Billion Heist to Prompt Closer Scrutiny by Insurers
items.summary: Insignia underwriters are preparing to demand stricter security disclosures from crypto firms following a record $6.3 billion cyber theft.

items.title: Man Group Found Liable in Kuwaiti bribery lawsuit
items.summary: A London judge has ruled that Man Group could have to pay around $155 million for its role in a sprawling bribery scheme.

items.title: UK to introduce mandatory human rights due diligence regime
items.summary: The UK government plans to implement a mandatory human rights due diligence framework covering services nationwide and goods in Great Britain.

items.title: Pet insurers cut prices hardest on lowest-cover policies
items.summary: Average top-five prices for Lifetime pet insurance fell 14% over the past 12 months, with the steepest cuts applied to the lowest-cover policies.

items.title: DWP, TPR and FCA launch guided retirement consultation
items.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions, The Pensions Regulator and the Financial Conduct Authority have launched a consultation on guided retirement.

items.title: Westminster asbestos discoveries highlight limitations in building surveys
items.summary: Recent asbestos discoveries across the parliamentary estate illustrate ongoing survey gaps and long-tail liability exposures for property owners and underwriters, according to industry sources.
